storage_topology.project_main: one main SQL database under each .pf; exact filename and schema namespace to be frozen by W2/W4
storage_topology.workplace_main: one main SQL database; prefer compatible evolution/consolidation of existing accounting store, never an additional permanent subsystem database
storage_topology.legacy_project_journals: existing events/hooks databases remain transitional until explicit migration; no automatic move/delete

authority_rules: One logical lifecycle writer service per attempt, used by CLI/MCP/Runtime; different processes serialize through the same repository contract.
Work state and execution state are separate: completed process is not approved task; completed task is not proof of exited process.
Ledger owns session binding; attempt links do not rebind sessions.
Artifacts and immutable capsules remain files; SQL owns indexes/references or explicitly migrated facts, not competing editable bodies.
Workplace project summaries carry source revision and coverage; they cannot mutate project state or prove idle from stale absence.
proposed_contract.execution_instance_id: proposed internal opaque generation; project-root path is routing, PID alone is not identity
operational_tables: execution_current (only unresolved physical executions; FK/reference to attempt)
proposed_contract.atomicity: terminal attempt update and removal from execution_current in one project transaction; one versioned lifecycle fact, not independently mutable current/history copies
proposed_contract.history: indexed keyset pages on stable sequence; no full-history read on normal start/status/stop
proposed_contract.receipt_authority: heartbeat/exit files are producer evidence; one controller applies exact attempt-bound receipts, checks duplicate/conflicting IDs and projects legacy status.json
proposed_contract.uncertainty: unknown current execution blocks idle; missing optional old history does not. Proven absence of process can clear physical activity without inventing successful exit or successful collection.
proposed_contract.start_stop: durable reservation before Popen; launch/stop admission fence must cover CLI and Runtime together. Runtime state_lock alone is insufficient. W3 must freeze locking order and recovery with W2/W4 before implementation.
proposed_contract.file_only: direct local SQLite through Core, no daemon, MCP, network, server backend or LLM required; do not instantiate workplace storage when not needed by the existing command

minimal_slice: Freeze database location/schema ownership and lifecycle ports; no new public CLI/MCP contract.
Implement SQLite project execution repository and explicit legacy import with readiness marker.

Replace shutdown_workers worker scan and RuntimeProcess.active_worker_count with indexed unresolved execution reads; reconcile only exact active attempt receipts.
Use workplace summaries only as projections; guard obtains complete current project observations and checks start/stop fencing.
Qualify old CLI/MCP/file-only behavior and 400000 completed attempts with 0/1/multiple active executions before accepting the cutover.

suggested_implementation_ownership.remit: Freeze domain types, identity and repository protocols with W2/W3; document authority. Proposed paths, not current product files.
Shared SQL API, first SQLite driver, domain schema versioning and composition. Touch existing files only if required by frozen contract.
Single owner for shared integration files; attempt lifecycle, receipts, guard/counter and launch fence. All CLI registration changes from W2/W4 go through W3 serially.
Reuse maintenance/update ownership; plan/import/checkpoint/quarantine/rollback and portable project export. No live migration in design assignment.

dependencies.api: SQL transaction/read-only connection contract, domain schema version/readiness, configured project/workplace locations; SQLite-specific errors translated safely
ExecutionAttempt/ExecutionObservation, scoped ExecutionRepository reserve/mark_running/apply_receipt/finish/current/history_page; exact method signatures to freeze jointly
Attempt-bound receipts, reservation/start fence, writer epoch and recoverable in-flight protocol
Migration readiness and explicit authority marker; no fallback to legacy writer after SQL cutover
Freeze precise file ownership and locking contract before scoped implementation Work; this map grants no implementation permissions

required_scenarios: 400000 completed attempts with 0, 1 and multiple current executions; query plan and read counts independent of history
start-vs-stop across CLI and Runtime; crash before/after spawn and terminal transaction; PID reuse and stale heartbeat
old attempt receipt after retry; conflict/idempotency; process exit distinct from output acceptance
migration interruption/resume/rollback/quarantine; explicit old-writer fence; backup integrity
same project copied to new root; unchanged project/run/task/attempt IDs and relative artifacts; workplace mappings rebuilt explicitly
same public CLI/MCP parameters, payloads, errors, report files and file-only flow; missing DB read does not create storage
logging disabled retains operational admissions/current execution; stale/missing summary never becomes exact zero
regression_evidence.qa: pytest/Ruff/format/mypy not applicable to artifact-only design; implementation checks require new scoped grants and actual commands/results

limitations: No Serena/IDE navigation tool was available; bounded shell fallback used.
No runtime/history data, live databases or workplace bodies were opened; inventory describes source code and local docs.
Some temporary test directories denied access during filename inventory; no override attempted.
READ_ACK, heartbeat and RESULT_READY were not sent: prepared scope grants only read/write_artifact in W1-owned paths and no Ledger/chat mutation grant.
No new Work, context rebuild, lifecycle transition, product edits, new tests, commits, push or infrastructure operations.
Current source hashes are observation evidence, not a frozen accepted candidate; reread before implementation.
safe_markdown_projection_rules: Только явно generated task-index/status/technical views можно перестраивать из canonical source; ручная правка представления не меняет lifecycle.
Содержательные отчёты, решения, approved evidence и handoff bytes остаются артефактами; запрещён общий rebuild, переписывающий их.
Проекция содержит источник, ревизию и свежесть; после ошибки публикации canonical transaction остаётся истиной, projection получает stale и может быть повторена.
Никакого импорта стадий или разрешений из произвольного Markdown; текущие scope/capsule/selector checks сохраняются.
schema_merge_risk: sqlite_storage.database and SQLiteAccountingRepository verify database-wide application_id/user_version. A shared main database needs one physical identity plus domain-specific schema versions and namespaced metadata. Redirecting all old repositories to the same file is not a migration.
